title: Choose your course and university
whatHappens: Italy has over 90 universities and around 5,000 degree programmes, including a growing number taught entirely in English. You pick a course, a university, and a city — three decisions that shape your budget, your daily life, and your visa file.
whoDecides: You. But the choice affects what each university and consulate will later ask you for.
timing: Usually 6–9 months before the academic year starts, to leave enough room for the steps that follow.
whatCanGoWrong: Choosing a course far from your previous studies without a clear reason can raise questions at the consulate later.
whatKimereDoes: We match your academic background and budget to real programmes and cities — not just rankings — so the choice holds up at every later step.
